empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills
drawer.pickLead: Pick a Markdown file, or a .zip bundle containing a SKILL.md. The file is parsed and shown here first — nothing is saved until you confirm.
drawer.savedDisabled: Saved disabled, for you to vet first

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.
file.zipTooLarge: That archive is larger than {max} KB. Import the SKILL.md on its own instead.
file.ignoredTitle: {count, plural, one {# file ignored} other {# files ignored}}
file.ignoredHint: Only the SKILL.md was read. These entries were listed from the archive index and never opened, written to disk, or executed.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.lead: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

config.heading: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: The skill’s interface. State directly when it applies — "Apply when a diff touches a route…" — so an agent can tell whether to reach for it.
config.typeHint: Grouping only. It does not change how the skill is used.
config.bodyHint: The only text sent to the model. Everything above is metadata; editing the body is editing the skill.
config.willVersion: Saving snapshots the body as v{version}
config.deleteBody: Removes it from every agent that uses it. This cannot be undone.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It will be removed from every agent that uses it.
